Accurate Food Emissions Data That Food Leaders Trust
Food carbon data is scattered across procurement systems and supplier files. We turn it into accurate, audit-ready reporting with clarity, confidence, and ease. Measure food emissions automatically, report across Scope 1-3, track product carbon footprints, and reduce climate impact with labels your customers can verify.
Gain Insights on Food Emissions 
in Greater Detail and at Scale
Klimato delivers granular, food-specific emissions data, deep industry expertise, and flexible solutions so food businesses can measure their impact, report with confidence, and take action that reduces emissions.
What sets Klimato apart:
- 
Food-specific emissions data verified against international standards
- 
Flexible products that integrate with your existing procurement and reporting systems
- 
Insights that connect sustainability performance to operational decisions
- 
Expert support across full Scope 1, 2, and 3 reporting, including Scope 3, Category 1 (purchased goods and services)
The go-to solution for measuring and reporting on food-related environmental impact
Meet your sustainability goals
So, you’ve set ambitious sustainability targets, now what? We’ve removed the complexity from environmental impact reporting without sacrificing precision, making it easy for you to track and report on your progress.
Elevate your branding
Klimato puts you on the map for climate-conscious consumers and gives you new opportunities to communicate what you do best. Use our labels and marketing resources to grow awareness of your brand and its mission.
Drive revenue through behaviour change
With Klimato, knowing your impact means improving your bottom line. We give you the tools to guide consumers to revenue-optimized, plant-rich dishes.
Get ahead of compliance
Whether you’re reporting to key stakeholders, readying yourself for upcoming sustainability legislation or looking to attract corporate clients, our reports ensure transparency and precision.
Designed for Teams Where Getting Food Emissions Right Matters
Clear Insights from Day One
Gain a clear, accurate picture of your food emissions. Klimato transforms your procurement data into granular, activity-based emission factors automatically, so your team can report with precision and know exactly where to reduce.
Built on Trusted Methodology
All emission factors come from the Klimato database, built from peer-reviewed Life Cycle Assessment studies and aligned with the GHG Protocol. Every figure is traceable, so you can explain it, defend it, and use it to guide operational decisions.
Fits How You Already Work
No two food businesses look the same. Klimato can fit around your existing systems, cleans and structures your data, maps everything to accurate emission factors, and delivers it straight back where your team already works.
Verified Carbon Data Aligned 
with the GHG Protocol
Klimato’s verified emissions data powers everything from internal decision-making and ESG reporting to guest-facing climate labels, covering 4,000+ ingredients and 20,000 variations by production method and origin.
Our methodology aligns with the GHG Protocol, WRI, and IVL standards—the same foundation used across our reporting and decarbonization tools. This means your reporting insights are always accurate, traceable, and compliant. Klimato’s methodology supports both food-specific emissions analysis and full-scope reporting frameworks, ensuring consistency between operational insights and corporate disclosures.

Leading Food Operations Around the World
We support foodservice operators, restaurants, hotels, and food brand manufacturers, where emissions data needs to hold up across decisions, reporting, and day-to-day operations.

pages.title: Contact Klimato | Sustainability Solutions & Support
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Get in Touch with Klimato
We’re here to help you on your journey toward sustainability. Whether you’re an existing client, exploring our carbon footprint solutions, or have a general question, our team is ready to assist.
How can we help you? 
Contact Us
Locations
Our Offices
London
68 Hanbury St
E1 5JL
Stockholm
Kungsholmstorg 6
112 21
Frequently Asked QUestions
What exactly does Klimato do, and who is it for?
Klimato helps food businesses understand and reduce the climate impact of food. The solution is used by restaurants, caterers, hotels, and food producers that already work with sustainability and need food-specific emissions data they can trust. 
In practice, Klimato supports teams that need to move from intention to action. That means turning food data into something that works across menus, procurement, reporting, and communication, without starting from scratch or rebuilding existing workflows.
How does Klimato calculate food-related carbon emissions, and what data is it based on?
Klimato calculates food-related carbon emissions using science-based life cycle assessment (LCA) data. The calculations account for differences between ingredients, sourcing, and production methods, which is where many food businesses struggle to get reliable answers.
How this plays out in practice depends on what food is served, how it is sourced, and how data is used across teams. Klimato is designed to make these differences visible and usable, not just technically correct.
What problems does Klimato help food businesses solve in practice?
Food businesses often face pressure from many directions at once, from internal teams, clients, investors, and regulators. Klimato helps bring clarity where sustainability work is often fragmented.
By standardizing food emissions data and reducing manual reporting, Klimato helps teams align on one shared way of working with food climate impact. This makes it easier to answer questions, spot risks, and focus effort where it actually makes a difference.
What makes Klimato different from other sustainability or carbon tools?
Klimato is built specifically for food. Unlike general carbon accounting tools, it focuses on food-related emissions, which typically make up a large share of climate impact in food businesses.
The solution combines detailed food climate data with practical workflows designed for real-world use. This allows sustainability to stay connected to daily decisions, not locked away in reports or spreadsheets.

Seamless Scope 3 Integrations Built for How You Already Work
Your existing food management systems already hold the activity data you need for Scope 3 reporting. Klimato connects directly to your recipe management and procurement—so carbon footprint data stays current, accurate, and audit-ready without manual exports or re-uploads.
Connect the Platforms You Already Use
Klimato integrates with recipe management systems and procurement platforms. 
Whichever platform your team relies on, carbon footprint data flows directly into your existing workflow—no new interface to learn, no parallel data entry.

Make sure to let your partner know your interest in Klimato, and let us know your integration blockers. We'll take care of the rest.
Gain Hours Back With Data You Can Trust
For large food businesses under CSRD, SBTi, or corporate net-zero commitments, Scope 3 Category 1 (Purchased Food & Beverage) typically accounts for up to 95% of total emissions, and it's the hardest category to report accurately. Every integration follows the same core process, designed to get your data mapped accurately before carbon footprints are delivered back to your platform.
1. Product Catalog Mapping
Your system's ingredient and product catalog is mapped to Klimato's emissions database using a combination of machine learning, string similarity algorithms, and manual review by Klimato's customer success team. Every item is validated for accuracy before going live.
2. Carbon Data Delivery
Once mapping is complete, Klimato delivers emission factors and carbon footprint figures back to your platform—either through the integration partner's own systems or via the Mapping API. Your recipes, menus, and food items show accurate, up-to-date footprints without any manual data entry.
3. Ongoing Sync
As your product catalog changes and as Klimato updates its emissions database (3–4 times per year), figures stay current automatically. No re-exports, no re-uploads, no periodic manual refresh.
4. Expanded Data Points
With a synced catalog in place, you can connect additional data flows—recipes, menus, sales data, and procurement records—to build a comprehensive, activity-based picture of your food emissions.
The Difference an Integration Makes
Food businesses relying on manual CSV workflows typically spend 8–12 hours per week on data export, cleaning, and re-upload just to keep their emissions figures current. An integration eliminates that entirely.
How Integrations Can Streamline Your Climate Reporting
Klimato integrations connect seamlessly with your existing recipe management, procurement, and point-of-sale (POS) systems, ensuring that carbon footprint tracking and reporting are no longer tedious tasks.
This guide will explore the benefits of our integration products, dive into practical examples, and offer strategic advice for leveraging these tools to future-proof your business.
Where Should We Send Your Guide?
Accurate, Food-Specific Emissions Data Built for Scale
Klimato's central emissions database contains 4,000+ unique ingredients with over 20,000 variations based on country of origin and production method. Emission factors are peer-reviewed, ISO-compliant, and updated 3–4 times per year to reflect the latest science and supply chain data.
Every ingredient mapped through a Klimato integration is validated by Klimato's customer success team before going live, combining automated mapping technology with human quality assurance. This makes Klimato's approach fundamentally different from generic ESG platforms: the data is built specifically for food supply chains, not adapted from cross-industry averages.
FAQ About Integrations
Which platforms does Klimato integrate with?
Klimato currently has active integrations with Millum (procurement), Delegate (recipe management), Kitchen CUT (kitchen and recipe management), ApicBase (food and beverage management), Indicater (recipe and menu management), and Parsley (food management, US). pages.title: Klimato Team | Food Emissions Science & Technology Experts
pages.main_text_excerpt:
We Love Food, But Think It Should Come with Fewer Emissions
Food production accounts for roughly a third of global greenhouse gas emissions. Yet, most food businesses still lack the data infrastructure to understand, let alone reduce, their climate impact.
Klimato was founded to change that. From our location in Stockholm, Sweden, we build tools grounded in food science and verified emissions data, helping businesses move from guesswork to structured reporting. Whether that means calculating Scope 3 category 1 emissions, meeting CSRD disclosure requirements, or setting a credible reduction path, we give teams the accuracy and the confidence to act.
Meet The Team Driving Klimato Forward
Our team combines backgrounds in sustainability science, finance, product development, and enterprise software, united by a shared conviction that food businesses can operate more sustainably and that better data makes that possible.
Our Core Values
These aren't aspirations on a wall, but behaviors we hold each other to every day.
Accountability
We take ownership of our work—the wins and the mistakes. Accountability is what makes all our other values real: without it, trust erodes, openness stalls, and action loses direction.
Trust
We trust each other to do our best. That means believing in each other's competence and commitment, and not second-guessing people who know their work.
Openness
We communicate honestly, share what we know, and ask for help when we need it. The best outcomes at Klimato have come from people saying what they actually think.
Respect
We value each other's time, ideas, and perspectives, even when we disagree. That means showing up, following through, and treating colleagues' contributions as seriously as our own.
Passion
We care about what we're building and why we're building it. That passion is contagious—it raises the bar for everyone and keeps us motivated when the work gets hard.
A Place Where the Work Feels Personal
We're a small team working on something we genuinely care about. That means you'll own your work from day one, hear honest feedback, and be surrounded by people who bring real curiosity to hard problems.
Our team spans across the world—food scientists, engineers, sustainability specialists, and commercial minds, all working closely together. We move quickly, but we take the time to get things right where it matters. New ideas are tested, not dismissed. And when things don't go as planned, we talk about it openly and move forward together.
Work That Has Real Impact
Every feature we ship, every client we onboard, contributes to measurable emissions reductions across global food supply chains. The problem is real. So is the progress.
Space to Think and Build
We move quickly, but we don't sacrifice depth for speed. New ideas get tested, not dismissed. Scientists and engineers work side by side to solve problems that don't have easy answers.
People Who Raise the Bar
Our team spans Stockholm, London, and beyond. We hire for expertise and curiosity, and we invest in each other—because the best work comes from people who genuinely support each other.
About Klimato
Who founded Klimato and when?
Klimato was founded in 2017 by Anton Unger and co-founders, with a focus on giving food businesses access to the verified emissions data they need to take meaningful climate action. The company is headquartered in Stockholm.
What scientific standards does Klimato's methodology follow?
Klimato's emissions calculations are built on lifecycle assessment methodology aligned with ISO 14040, 14044, and 14067, and follow GHG Protocol Scope 3 standards. Our Science team maintains and continuously updates the underlying emissions database, drawing on peer-reviewed research across global food systems and agricultural supply chains.
What types of food businesses does Klimato work with?
Klimato works with large food businesses that have significant food-related emissions and active sustainability commitments—including contract caterers, hotel and hospitality groups, food producers, and wholesalers. Our solution is designed for organizations managing complex, multi-site operations where food emissions reporting needs to integrate with existing procurement and finance workflows.
How does Klimato support CSRD and Scope 3 reporting?
Klimato's Corporate Carbon Accounting and F&B Emissions Reporting tools are built specifically to support the disclosure requirements that large food businesses face under CSRD and GHG Protocol Scope 3, Category 1. Our platform connects food purchasing data to verified emissions factors, producing audit-ready outputs that sustainability and finance teams can use directly in regulatory reporting.
Where are Klimato's offices?
Klimato operates from Stockholm (Kungsholmstorg 6, 112 21) but we act global. Our HQ presence means we work closely with food businesses across the the Nordics, UK and the broader European market.

The Latest News From and About Klimato
Welcome to the Klimato Newsroom; your go-to source for the latest updates, press releases, media coverage, and resources relating to Klimato. Here, you’ll find our latest announcements, industry insights, and media assets designed to keep journalists, partners, and the public informed.
The Land Emissions Blind Spot Food Companies Need to Close Before 2027
A new global standard is about to make land use change and land management emissions as accountable as fuel and electricity. Most food businesses aren't ready, and the reason is their data.
Read press release →
Klimato and Apicbase Integrate to Put Food Emissions Data Where F&B Teams Actually Work
Apicbase customers can now access Klimato's ingredient-level carbon data directly in their F&B platform, no exports or extra logins required.
Read press release →
How Klimato and Kitchen CUT Are Bringing Carbon Data Into Daily Hospitality Operations
For most F&B teams, sustainability data arrives too late to change anything. Klimato and Kitchen CUT are changing where in the workflow it shows up, and what hospitality operators can actually do with it.
Read press release →
Why Most Food Companies Are Getting Carbon Reporting Wrong
Despite genuine sustainability commitments, many food businesses are measuring emissions in ways that make it nearly impossible to reduce them. Here's what's going wrong, and what needs to change.
Read article →
Radisson plans 100 net-zero hotels by 2030 supported by Klimato
Successful pilot sites led to increased revenue and guest awareness, driving Radisson’s net-zero plans despite operational and regional constraints.

Klimato Joins UK Food and Drink Pactto Drive a More Sustainable Food System

Klimato partners with Procure Wizard to help UK food businesses reduce environmental footprint

Accurate Food Emissions Data That Food Leaders Trust
Food carbon data is scattered across procurement systems and supplier files. We turn it into accurate, audit-ready reporting with clarity, confidence, and ease. Measure food emissions automatically, report across Scope 1-3, track product carbon footprints, and reduce climate impact with labels your customers can verify.
Gain Insights on Food Emissions 
in Greater Detail and at Scale
Klimato delivers granular, food-specific emissions data, deep industry expertise, and flexible solutions so food businesses can measure their impact, report with confidence, and take action that reduces emissions.
What sets Klimato apart:
- 
Food-specific emissions data verified against international standards
- 
Flexible products that integrate with your existing procurement and reporting systems
- 
Insights that connect sustainability performance to operational decisions
- 
Expert support across full Scope 1, 2, and 3 reporting, including Scope 3, Category 1 (purchased goods and services)
The go-to solution for measuring and reporting on food-related environmental impact
Meet your sustainability goals
So, you’ve set ambitious sustainability targets, now what? We’ve removed the complexity from environmental impact reporting without sacrificing precision, making it easy for you to track and report on your progress.
Elevate your branding
Klimato puts you on the map for climate-conscious consumers and gives you new opportunities to communicate what you do best. Use our labels and marketing resources to grow awareness of your brand and its mission.
Drive revenue through behaviour change
With Klimato, knowing your impact means improving your bottom line. We give you the tools to guide consumers to revenue-optimized, plant-rich dishes.
Get ahead of compliance
Whether you’re reporting to key stakeholders, readying yourself for upcoming sustainability legislation or looking to attract corporate clients, our reports ensure transparency and precision.
Designed for Teams Where Getting Food Emissions Right Matters
Clear Insights from Day One
Gain a clear, accurate picture of your food emissions. Klimato transforms your procurement data into granular, activity-based emission factors automatically, so your team can report with precision and know exactly where to reduce.
Built on Trusted Methodology
All emission factors come from the Klimato database, built from peer-reviewed Life Cycle Assessment studies and aligned with the GHG Protocol. Every figure is traceable, so you can explain it, defend it, and use it to guide operational decisions.
Fits How You Already Work
No two food businesses look the same. Klimato can fit around your existing systems, cleans and structures your data, maps everything to accurate emission factors, and delivers it straight back where your team already works.
Verified Carbon Data Aligned 
with the GHG Protocol
Klimato’s verified emissions data powers everything from internal decision-making and ESG reporting to guest-facing climate labels, covering 4,000+ ingredients and 20,000 variations by production method and origin.
Our methodology aligns with the GHG Protocol, WRI, and IVL standards—the same foundation used across our reporting and decarbonization tools. This means your reporting insights are always accurate, traceable, and compliant. Klimato’s methodology supports both food-specific emissions analysis and full-scope reporting frameworks, ensuring consistency between operational insights and corporate disclosures.

Leading Food Operations Around the World
We support foodservice operators, restaurants, hotels, and food brand manufacturers, where emissions data needs to hold up across decisions, reporting, and day-to-day operations.

pages.title: Contact Klimato | Sustainability Solutions & Support
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Get in Touch with Klimato
We’re here to help you on your journey toward sustainability. Whether you’re an existing client, exploring our carbon footprint solutions, or have a general question, our team is ready to assist.
How can we help you? 
Contact Us
Locations
Our Offices
London
68 Hanbury St
E1 5JL
Stockholm
Kungsholmstorg 6
112 21
Frequently Asked QUestions
What exactly does Klimato do, and who is it for?
Klimato helps food businesses understand and reduce the climate impact of food. The solution is used by restaurants, caterers, hotels, and food producers that already work with sustainability and need food-specific emissions data they can trust. 
In practice, Klimato supports teams that need to move from intention to action. That means turning food data into something that works across menus, procurement, reporting, and communication, without starting from scratch or rebuilding existing workflows.
How does Klimato calculate food-related carbon emissions, and what data is it based on?
Klimato calculates food-related carbon emissions using science-based life cycle assessment (LCA) data. The calculations account for differences between ingredients, sourcing, and production methods, which is where many food businesses struggle to get reliable answers.
How this plays out in practice depends on what food is served, how it is sourced, and how data is used across teams. Klimato is designed to make these differences visible and usable, not just technically correct.
What problems does Klimato help food businesses solve in practice?
Food businesses often face pressure from many directions at once, from internal teams, clients, investors, and regulators. Klimato helps bring clarity where sustainability work is often fragmented.
By standardizing food emissions data and reducing manual reporting, Klimato helps teams align on one shared way of working with food climate impact. This makes it easier to answer questions, spot risks, and focus effort where it actually makes a difference.
What makes Klimato different from other sustainability or carbon tools?
Klimato is built specifically for food. Unlike general carbon accounting tools, it focuses on food-related emissions, which typically make up a large share of climate impact in food businesses.
The solution combines detailed food climate data with practical workflows designed for real-world use. This allows sustainability to stay connected to daily decisions, not locked away in reports or spreadsheets.

Seamless Scope 3 Integrations Built for How You Already Work
Your existing food management systems already hold the activity data you need for Scope 3 reporting. Klimato connects directly to your recipe management and procurement—so carbon footprint data stays current, accurate, and audit-ready without manual exports or re-uploads.
Connect the Platforms You Already Use
Klimato integrates with recipe management systems and procurement platforms. 
Whichever platform your team relies on, carbon footprint data flows directly into your existing workflow—no new interface to learn, no parallel data entry.

Make sure to let your partner know your interest in Klimato, and let us know your integration blockers. We'll take care of the rest.
Gain Hours Back With Data You Can Trust
For large food businesses under CSRD, SBTi, or corporate net-zero commitments, Scope 3 Category 1 (Purchased Food & Beverage) typically accounts for up to 95% of total emissions, and it's the hardest category to report accurately. Every integration follows the same core process, designed to get your data mapped accurately before carbon footprints are delivered back to your platform.
1. Product Catalog Mapping
Your system's ingredient and product catalog is mapped to Klimato's emissions database using a combination of machine learning, string similarity algorithms, and manual review by Klimato's customer success team. Every item is validated for accuracy before going live.
2. Carbon Data Delivery
Once mapping is complete, Klimato delivers emission factors and carbon footprint figures back to your platform—either through the integration partner's own systems or via the Mapping API. Your recipes, menus, and food items show accurate, up-to-date footprints without any manual data entry.
3. Ongoing Sync
As your product catalog changes and as Klimato updates its emissions database (3–4 times per year), figures stay current automatically. No re-exports, no re-uploads, no periodic manual refresh.
4. Expanded Data Points
With a synced catalog in place, you can connect additional data flows—recipes, menus, sales data, and procurement records—to build a comprehensive, activity-based picture of your food emissions.
The Difference an Integration Makes
Food businesses relying on manual CSV workflows typically spend 8–12 hours per week on data export, cleaning, and re-upload just to keep their emissions figures current. An integration eliminates that entirely.
How Integrations Can Streamline Your Climate Reporting
Klimato integrations connect seamlessly with your existing recipe management, procurement, and point-of-sale (POS) systems, ensuring that carbon footprint tracking and reporting are no longer tedious tasks.
This guide will explore the benefits of our integration products, dive into practical examples, and offer strategic advice for leveraging these tools to future-proof your business.
Where Should We Send Your Guide?
Accurate, Food-Specific Emissions Data Built for Scale
Klimato's central emissions database contains 4,000+ unique ingredients with over 20,000 variations based on country of origin and production method. Emission factors are peer-reviewed, ISO-compliant, and updated 3–4 times per year to reflect the latest science and supply chain data.
Every ingredient mapped through a Klimato integration is validated by Klimato's customer success team before going live, combining automated mapping technology with human quality assurance. This makes Klimato's approach fundamentally different from generic ESG platforms: the data is built specifically for food supply chains, not adapted from cross-industry averages.
FAQ About Integrations
Which platforms does Klimato integrate with?
Klimato currently has active integrations with Millum (procurement), Delegate (recipe management), Kitchen CUT (kitchen and recipe management), ApicBase (food and beverage management), Indicater (recipe and menu management), and Parsley (food management, US). pages.title: Klimato Team | Food Emissions Science & Technology Experts
pages.main_text_excerpt:
We Love Food, But Think It Should Come with Fewer Emissions
Food production accounts for roughly a third of global greenhouse gas emissions. Yet, most food businesses still lack the data infrastructure to understand, let alone reduce, their climate impact.
Klimato was founded to change that. From our location in Stockholm, Sweden, we build tools grounded in food science and verified emissions data, helping businesses move from guesswork to structured reporting. Whether that means calculating Scope 3 category 1 emissions, meeting CSRD disclosure requirements, or setting a credible reduction path, we give teams the accuracy and the confidence to act.
Meet The Team Driving Klimato Forward
Our team combines backgrounds in sustainability science, finance, product development, and enterprise software, united by a shared conviction that food businesses can operate more sustainably and that better data makes that possible.
Our Core Values
These aren't aspirations on a wall, but behaviors we hold each other to every day.
Accountability
We take ownership of our work—the wins and the mistakes. Accountability is what makes all our other values real: without it, trust erodes, openness stalls, and action loses direction.
Trust
We trust each other to do our best. That means believing in each other's competence and commitment, and not second-guessing people who know their work.
Openness
We communicate honestly, share what we know, and ask for help when we need it. The best outcomes at Klimato have come from people saying what they actually think.
Respect
We value each other's time, ideas, and perspectives, even when we disagree. That means showing up, following through, and treating colleagues' contributions as seriously as our own.
Passion
We care about what we're building and why we're building it. That passion is contagious—it raises the bar for everyone and keeps us motivated when the work gets hard.
A Place Where the Work Feels Personal
We're a small team working on something we genuinely care about. That means you'll own your work from day one, hear honest feedback, and be surrounded by people who bring real curiosity to hard problems.
Our team spans across the world—food scientists, engineers, sustainability specialists, and commercial minds, all working closely together. We move quickly, but we take the time to get things right where it matters. New ideas are tested, not dismissed. And when things don't go as planned, we talk about it openly and move forward together.
Work That Has Real Impact
Every feature we ship, every client we onboard, contributes to measurable emissions reductions across global food supply chains. The problem is real. So is the progress.
Space to Think and Build
We move quickly, but we don't sacrifice depth for speed. New ideas get tested, not dismissed. Scientists and engineers work side by side to solve problems that don't have easy answers.
People Who Raise the Bar
Our team spans Stockholm, London, and beyond. We hire for expertise and curiosity, and we invest in each other—because the best work comes from people who genuinely support each other.
About Klimato
Who founded Klimato and when?
Klimato was founded in 2017 by Anton Unger and co-founders, with a focus on giving food businesses access to the verified emissions data they need to take meaningful climate action. The company is headquartered in Stockholm.
What scientific standards does Klimato's methodology follow?
Klimato's emissions calculations are built on lifecycle assessment methodology aligned with ISO 14040, 14044, and 14067, and follow GHG Protocol Scope 3 standards. Our Science team maintains and continuously updates the underlying emissions database, drawing on peer-reviewed research across global food systems and agricultural supply chains.
What types of food businesses does Klimato work with?
Klimato works with large food businesses that have significant food-related emissions and active sustainability commitments—including contract caterers, hotel and hospitality groups, food producers, and wholesalers. Our solution is designed for organizations managing complex, multi-site operations where food emissions reporting needs to integrate with existing procurement and finance workflows.
How does Klimato support CSRD and Scope 3 reporting?
Klimato's Corporate Carbon Accounting and F&B Emissions Reporting tools are built specifically to support the disclosure requirements that large food businesses face under CSRD and GHG Protocol Scope 3, Category 1. Our platform connects food purchasing data to verified emissions factors, producing audit-ready outputs that sustainability and finance teams can use directly in regulatory reporting.
Where are Klimato's offices?
Klimato operates from Stockholm (Kungsholmstorg 6, 112 21) but we act global. Our HQ presence means we work closely with food businesses across the the Nordics, UK and the broader European market.

Welcome to the Klimato Newsroom; your go-to source for the latest updates, press releases, media coverage, and resources relating to Klimato. Here, you’ll find our latest announcements, industry insights, and media assets designed to keep journalists, partners, and the public informed.
The Land Emissions Blind Spot Food Companies Need to Close Before 2027
A new global standard is about to make land use change and land management emissions as accountable as fuel and electricity. Most food businesses aren't ready, and the reason is their data.

Klimato and Apicbase Integrate to Put Food Emissions Data Where F&B Teams Actually Work

How Klimato and Kitchen CUT Are Bringing Carbon Data Into Daily Hospitality Operations
For most F&B teams, sustainability data arrives too late to change anything. Klimato and Kitchen CUT are changing where in the workflow it shows up, and what hospitality operators can actually do with it.

Why Most Food Companies Are Getting Carbon Reporting Wrong
